units.literal: Moreover, southeastern commanderies and districts each had cattle-rent levy households; formerly because Emperor Taizu of Liang crossed the Huai, soldiers seized civilian oxen by the millions; Emperor Taizu of Liang gave them all to the people of the various prefectures to pay rent levies—from then more than sixty years had passed, dynasties had changed, yet the cattle rent remained, and the people suffered; now it was specially remitted.

units.zh: 未幾，京兆府莊宅務及榷鹽務亦歸州縣，依例處分。
units.en: Before long, the Metropolitan Estate Office and Salt Monopoly Office also passed to prefectures and counties and were disposed of according to regulation.
units.literal: Before long, the Metropolitan Estate Office and Salt Monopoly Office also passed to prefectures and counties and were disposed of according to regulation.

units.zh: 或有上言，以天下系官莊田，甚有可惜者，若遣貨之，當得三十萬緡，亦可資國用。
units.en: Some submitted that the empire's government manors included much that would be a pity to give away; if sold, they could fetch three hundred thousand strings of cash and help supply state expenses.
units.literal: Some submitted that the empire's government manors included much that was quite regrettable to lose; if sold, they could fetch three hundred thousand strings of cash and could also supply state expenses.

units.zh: 帝曰：「茍利於民，與資國何異。」
units.en: The Emperor said: "If it benefits the people, how is that different from supplying the state?"
units.literal: The Emperor said: "If it benefits the people, how does that differ from supplying the state?

units.zh: 丁卯，戶部侍郎、權知貢舉趙上交奏：「諸科舉人，欲等第各加對義場數；
units.en: On dingmao, Zhao Shangjiao, Vice Minister of Revenue and acting director of examinations, submitted: "For examination candidates in all categories, we wish to add argument sessions to each grade ranking;
units.literal: On dingmao, Vice Minister of Revenue and acting director of examinations Zhao Shangjiao submitted: "Examination candidates in all categories—we wish to add argument sessions to each grade ranking;

units.zh: 進士除詩賦外，別試雜文一場。」
units.en: jinshi candidates, aside from poetry and fu, shall take an additional examination in miscellaneous prose."
units.literal: jinshi, aside from poetry and fu, shall take an additional examination in miscellaneous prose.

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The request was granted.
units.literal: The request was granted.

units.zh: 兩浙吊祭使、左諫議大夫李知損責授登州司馬，員外置，仍令所在馳驛放遣。
units.en: Li Zhisun, condolence envoy to the Two Zhes and Left Remonstrance Counselor, was demoted to Deng Prefecture vice prefect on a supernumerary basis and ordered dispatched by express relay from wherever he was.
units.literal: Li Zhisun, condolence envoy to the Two Zhes and Left Remonstrance Counselor, was demoted and appointed Deng Prefecture vice prefect, supernumerary, and was ordered dispatched by express relay from his location.

units.zh: 知損銜命江、浙，所經藩郡，皆強貸於侯伯，為青州知州張凝所奏，故有是命。
units.en: Zhisun, on imperial orders in Jiang and Zhe, had forcibly borrowed from marquises and earls at every feudal prefecture he passed; Qingzhou prefect Zhang Ning memorialized against him, and therefore came this order.
units.literal: Zhisun, bearing imperial orders in Jiang and Zhe, had at every feudal prefecture he passed forcibly borrowed from marquises and earls; Qing Prefecture prefect Zhang Ning memorialized against him, and therefore came this order.

units.zh: 己巳，幸南莊。
units.en: On jisi, the Emperor visited the Southern Villa.
units.literal: On jisi, the Emperor visited the Southern Villa.

units.zh: 臨水亭，見雙鳧戲於池上，帝引弓射之，一發疊貫，從臣稱賀。
units.en: At the Waterside Pavilion he saw two ducks sporting on the pond; the Emperor drew his bow and shot, one arrow piercing both; the attending ministers offered congratulations.
units.literal: At the Waterside Pavilion he saw two ducks sporting on the pond; the Emperor drew his bow and shot—one arrow pierced both; the attending ministers offered congratulations.

units.zh: 庚午，以前邠州節度使侯章為鄧州節度使。
units.en: On gengwu, former Binzhou military governor Hou Zhang was made military governor of Deng Prefecture.
units.literal: On gengwu, former Bin Prefecture military governor Hou Zhang was made military governor of Deng Prefecture.

units.zh: 前萊州刺史葉仁魯賜死，坐為民所訟故也。
units.en: Former Laizhou prefect Ye Renlu was granted death by edict because the people had brought suit against him.
units.literal: Former Laizhou prefect Ye Renlu was granted death by edict, because the people had brought suit against him.

units.zh: 辛未，詔樞密使王峻巡視河堤。
units.en: On xinwei, an edict ordered Military Affairs Commissioner Wang Jun to inspect the river dikes.
units.literal: On xinwei, an edict ordered Military Affairs Commissioner Wang Jun to inspect the river dikes.

units.zh: 峻請行，故從之。
units.en: Jun asked to go, and the order was granted.
units.literal: Jun requested to go, and therefore the order was granted.

units.zh: 辛巳，幸南莊。
units.en: On xinsi, the Emperor visited the Southern Villa.
units.literal: On xinsi, the Emperor visited the Southern Villa.

units.zh: 閏月甲申，朗州劉言、潭州王進逵奏，廣賊占據桂管，深入永州界俘劫，遣朗州行軍司馬何敬貞與指揮使朱全琇、陳順等，率水陸軍五萬進擊。
units.en: On jiashen in the intercalary month, Liu Yan of Langzhou and Wang Jinkui of Tanzhou submitted that Guang bandits occupied Gui Circuit, had penetrated deep into Yongzhou to capture and plunder, and had dispatched Langzhou campaign chief of staff He Jingzhen with commanders Zhu Quanxiu, Chen Shun, and others to lead fifty thousand land and water troops against them.
units.literal: On jiashen in the intercalary month, Liu Yan of Lang Prefecture and Wang Jinkui of Tan Prefecture submitted that Guang bandits occupied Gui Circuit administration, penetrated deep into Yong Prefecture's border to capture and plunder, and dispatched Langzhou campaign chief of staff He Jingzhen with commanders Zhu Quanxiu, Chen Shun, and others to lead fifty thousand land and water troops in a forward assault.

units.zh: 丙戊，回鶻遣使貢方物。
units.en: On bingxu, the Uyghurs sent envoys bearing tribute goods.
units.literal: On bingxu, the Uyghurs sent envoys presenting tribute goods.

units.zh: 詔故梁租庸使趙巖侄崇勛，見居陳州，量賜系官店宅，從王峻之請也。
units.en: An edict granted Zhao Chongxun, nephew of the former Liang Commissioner of Tax and Corvée Zhao Yan, then residing in Chenzhou, a measured grant of government tower-shops and residences, at Wang Jun's request.
units.literal: An edict granted Zhao Chongxun, nephew of the former Liang Commissioner of Tax and Corvée Zhao Yan, who was then residing in Chen Prefecture, a measured grant of government tower-shops and residences—following Wang Jun's request.

units.zh: 辛卯，定州奏，契丹攻義豐軍，出勁兵夜斫蕃營，斬首六十級，契丹遁去。
units.en: On xinmao, Dingzhou reported that when the Khitan attacked Yifeng Army, elite troops sallied at night and struck the barbarian camp, taking sixty heads, and the Khitan fled.
units.literal: On xinmao, Ding Prefecture reported that when the Khitan attacked Yifeng Army, elite troops sallied at night and struck the barbarian camp, taking sixty heads, and the Khitan fled.

units.zh: 甲午，鎮州奏，契丹寇境，遣兵追襲，至無極而還。
units.en: On jiawu, Zhenzhou reported that the Khitan raided the border; troops were dispatched in pursuit as far as Wuji and then returned.
units.literal: On jiawu, Zhen Prefecture reported that the Khitan raided the border; troops were dispatched in pursuit as far as Wuji and then returned.

units.zh: 丙申，皇子澶州節度使榮來朝。
units.en: On bingshen, Prince Rong, military governor of Cao Prefecture, came to court.
units.literal: On bingshen, Prince Rong, military governor of Cao Prefecture, came to court.

units.zh: 壬寅，以樞密使、尚書左僕射、同平章事、監修國史王峻兼青州節度使，餘如故。
units.en: On renyin, Wang Jun, Military Affairs Commissioner, Left Vice Minister of the Secretariat, co-equal Grand Councilor, and supervisor of the national history, was additionally made military governor of Qing Prefecture; his other posts remained unchanged.
units.literal: On renyin, Wang Jun, Military Affairs Commissioner, Left Vice Minister of the Secretariat, co-equal Grand Councilor, and supervisor of the national history, was additionally made military governor of Qing Prefecture; the rest of his posts remained unchanged.

units.zh: 延州衙內指揮使高紹基奏言：「父允權患腳膝，令臣權知軍州事。」
units.en: Yanzhou inner-palace commander Gao Shaoji submitted: "My father Yunquan suffers from knee and foot ailments and has ordered me to act as administrator of military and prefectural affairs."
units.literal: Yanzhou inner-palace commander Gao Shaoji submitted: "My father Yunquan suffers from knee and foot ailments and has ordered me to act as administrator of military and prefectural affairs.

units.zh: 癸卯，陳州奏：「吏民請與前刺史李穀立祠堂。」
units.en: On guimao, Chen Prefecture submitted: "Officials and people request to erect a memorial shrine for former prefect Li Gu."
units.literal: On guimao, Chen Prefecture submitted: "Officials and people request to erect a memorial shrine for former prefect Li Gu.

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The request was granted.
units.literal: The request was granted.

units.zh: 時穀為宰相，聞郡人陳請，遜讓數四，乃止。
units.en: At the time Gu was a chief councilor; hearing the local people's petition, he declined repeatedly, and the matter was dropped.
units.literal: At the time Gu was a chief councilor; hearing the county people's petition, he declined repeatedly, and the matter was stopped.

units.zh: 甲辰，鄴都留守王殷加檢校太尉，依前同平章事。
units.en: On jiachen, Ye Capital garrison commander Wang Yin was promoted to honorary Grand Guardian, continuing as co-equal Grand Councilor.
units.literal: On jiachen, Ye Capital garrison commander Wang Yin was promoted to honorary Grand Guardian, continuing as before as co-equal Grand Councilor.

units.zh: 丙午，鎮州節度使何福進、河陽節度使王彥超並加檢校太尉，潞州節度使李筠加檢校太傅。
units.en: On bingwu, Zhenzhou military governor He Fujin and Heyang military governor Wang Yanchao were both promoted to honorary Grand Guardian, and Luzhou military governor Li Yun was promoted to honorary Grand Mentor.
units.literal: On bingwu, Zhen Prefecture military governor He Fujin and Heyang military governor Wang Yanchao were both promoted to honorary Grand Guardian, and Lu Prefecture military governor Li Yun was promoted to honorary Grand Mentor.

units.zh: 丁未，延州節度使高允權卒。
units.en: On dingwei, Yanzhou military governor Gao Yunquan died.
units.literal: On dingwei, Yanzhou military governor Gao Yunquan died.

units.zh: 己酉，開封府奏，都城內錄到無名額僧尼寺院五十八所。
units.en: On jiyou, Kaifeng Prefecture submitted that fifty-eight Buddhist and Daoist temples without registered ordination tallies had been recorded within the capital.
units.literal: On jiyou, Kaifeng Prefecture submitted that within the capital city fifty-eight Buddhist and Daoist temples without registered ordination tallies had been recorded.

units.zh: 詔廢之。
units.en: An edict abolished them.
units.literal: An edict abolished them.

units.zh: 二月辛亥朔，以前西京留守白文珂為太子太師致仕，進封韓國公。
units.en: On the xinhai new moon of the second month, former Western Capital garrison commander Bai Wenke was made retired Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and enfeoffed as Duke of Han State.
units.literal: On the xinhai new moon of the second month, former Western Capital garrison commander Bai Wenke was made retired Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and advanced in enfeoffment to Duke of Han State.

units.zh: 癸丑，安州節度使李洪義、侍衛馬軍都指揮使郭崇、侍衛步軍都指揮使曹英，並加檢校太尉。
units.en: On guichou, Anzhou military governor Li Hongyi, mounted Imperial Guard commander-in-chief Guo Chong, and infantry Imperial Guard commander-in-chief Cao Ying were all promoted to honorary Grand Guardian.
units.literal: On guichou, Anzhou military governor Li Hongyi, commander-in-chief of the mounted Imperial Guard Guo Chong, and commander-in-chief of the infantry Imperial Guard Cao Ying were all promoted to honorary Grand Guardian.

units.zh: 唐州方城縣令陳守愚棄市，坐克留戶民蠶鹽一千五百斤入己也。
units.en: Chen Shouyu, magistrate of Fangcheng County in Tang Prefecture, was executed in the marketplace for having seized and kept one thousand five hundred jin of mulberry-tax salt from registered households for himself.
units.literal: Fangcheng county magistrate of Tang Prefecture Chen Shouyu was executed in the marketplace, for having seized and retained one thousand five hundred jin of mulberry-tax salt from registered households for himself.

units.zh: 內制國寶兩座，詔中書令馮道書寶文，其一以「皇帝承天受命之寶」為文，其一以「皇帝神寶」為文。
units.en: Two imperial treasure seals were fashioned within the palace, and an edict ordered Secretariat Director Feng Dao to inscribe them; one read "The Emperor's Seal of Receiving Heaven's Mandate," and the other read "The Emperor's Divine Seal."
units.literal: Two imperial treasure seals were fashioned within the palace, and an edict ordered Secretariat Director Feng Dao to write the seal texts; one bore the inscription "The Emperor's Seal of Receiving Heaven's Mandate," and one bore the inscription "The Emperor's Divine Seal."

units.zh: 案，傳國寶始自秦始皇，令李斯篆之，歷代傳授，事具前史。
units.en: Case note: The imperial heirloom seal began with the First Emperor of Qin, who had Li Si engrave it; it was handed down through successive dynasties, and the matter is fully recorded in earlier histories.
units.literal: Case note: The imperial heirloom seal began with the First Emperor of Qin, who had Li Si engrave it; it was transmitted through successive dynasties, and the matter is fully recorded in earlier histories.

units.zh: 至唐末帝自燔之際，以寶隨身，遂俱焚焉。
units.en: When the Last Emperor of Tang burned himself, he kept the seal on his person, and both perished in the flames.
units.literal: When the Last Emperor of Tang burned himself, he kept the seal on his person, and thus both perished in the flames.

units.zh: 晉高祖受命，特制寶一座，開運末，契丹犯闕，少帝遣其子延煦送於戎王，戎主，訝其非真，少帝上表具訴其事，及契丹北歸，賫以入蕃。
units.en: When Emperor Gaozu of Jin received the Mandate, a special seal was made; at the end of Kaiyun, when the Khitan violated the capital, the Young Emperor sent his son Yanxu to deliver it to the Khitan ruler. The Khitan lord, astonished that it was not genuine, received the Young Emperor's memorial fully setting forth the matter; when the Khitan returned north, they carried it into the steppe.
units.literal: When Emperor Gaozu of Jin received the Mandate, a special seal was made; at the end of Kaiyun, when the Khitan violated the capital, the Young Emperor sent his son Yanxu to deliver it to the Khitan ruler; the Khitan lord, astonished that it was not genuine, received the Young Emperor's memorial fully setting forth the matter; when the Khitan returned north, they carried it into the steppe.

units.zh: 漢朝二帝，未暇別制，至是始創為之。
units.en: The two emperors of Han had had no leisure to fashion new seals; only now were they first created.
units.literal: The two emperors of Han had had no leisure to fashion others separately; only now were they first created anew.

units.zh: 庚申，遣將作監李瓊知陜州軍州事。
units.en: On gengshen, Director of Palace Construction Li Qiong was dispatched to administer Shaan Prefecture military and prefectural affairs.
units.literal: On gengshen, Director of Palace Construction Li Qiong was dispatched to administer Shaan Prefecture military and prefectural affairs.

units.zh: 甲子，樞密使、平盧軍節度使、尚書左僕射、平章事、監修國史王峻責授商州司馬，員外置，所在馳驛發遣。
units.en: On jiazi, Wang Jun, Military Affairs Commissioner, military governor of the Pinglu Army, Left Vice Minister of the Secretariat, Grand Councilor, and supervisor of the national history, was demoted to Shang Prefecture vice prefect on a supernumerary basis and dispatched by express relay from wherever he was.
units.literal: On jiazi, Wang Jun, Military Affairs Commissioner, military governor of the Pinglu Army, Left Vice Minister of the Secretariat, Grand Councilor, and supervisor of the national history, was demoted and appointed Shang Prefecture vice prefect, supernumerary, and was dispatched by express relay from his location.

units.zh: 戊辰，左監門上將軍李建崇卒。
units.en: On wuchen, Left Gate Guard General Li Jianchong died.
units.literal: On wuchen, Left Gate Guard General Li Jianchong died.

units.zh: 延州牙內都指揮使高紹基奏，交割軍府與副使張圖。
units.en: Yanzhou inner-palace commander-in-chief Gao Shaoji submitted that he had transferred the military headquarters to vice commissioner Zhang Tu.
units.literal: Yanzhou inner-palace commander-in-chief Gao Shaoji submitted that he had transferred the military headquarters to vice commissioner Zhang Tu.

units.zh: 己巳，朗州劉言奏，當道先遣行軍司馬何敬貞率兵掩擊廣賊，行及潭州，部眾奔潰，湖南王進逵以敬貞失律，已梟首訖。
units.en: On jisi, Liu Yan of Langzhou submitted that this circuit had first dispatched campaign chief of staff He Jingzhen to lead a surprise attack on Guang bandits; when they reached Tanzhou the troops broke and fled; Wang Jinkui of Hunan, finding that Jingzhen had violated discipline, had already beheaded him.
units.literal: On jisi, Liu Yan of Lang Prefecture submitted that this circuit had first dispatched campaign chief of staff He Jingzhen to lead troops in a surprise assault on Guang bandits; when they reached Tan Prefecture the troops broke and fled; Wang Jinkui of Hunan, on the grounds that Jingzhen had violated discipline, had already beheaded him.

units.zh: 以樞密直學士、工部侍郎陳觀為秘書監。
units.en: Chen Guan, Palace Academician on Military Affairs and Vice Minister of Works, was made Director of the Palace Library.
units.literal: Palace Academician on Military Affairs Chen Guan, Vice Minister of Works, was made Director of the Palace Library.

units.zh: 壬申，鳳翔少尹桑能責授鄧州長史。
units.en: On renshen, Sang Neng, junior administrator of Fengxiang, was demoted to senior administrator of Deng Prefecture.
units.literal: On renshen, Sang Neng, junior administrator of Fengxiang, was demoted and appointed senior administrator of Deng Prefecture.

units.zh: 能，晉相維翰之庶弟也，坐據維翰別第為人所訟故也。
units.en: Neng was the younger half-brother of Jin chief councilor Sang Weihan; he was sued for occupying Weihan's separate residence, and therefore suffered this punishment.
units.literal: Neng was the younger half-brother of Jin chief councilor Sang Weihan; he was sued for occupying Weihan's separate residence, and therefore suffered this punishment.

units.zh: 癸酉，以戶部侍郎、知貢舉趙上交為太子詹事。
units.en: On guiyou, Zhao Shangjiao, Vice Minister of Revenue and director of examinations, was made Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
units.literal: On guiyou, Zhao Shangjiao, Vice Minister of Revenue and director of examinations, was made Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 是歲，新進士中有李觀者，不當策名，物議喧然，中書門下以觀所試詩賦失韻，勾落姓名，故上交移官。
units.en: That year among the newly passed jinshi was one Li Guan who should not have been listed; public criticism was loud; the Secretariat and Chancellery struck his name from the rolls because the poetry and fu he submitted violated rhyme rules; therefore Shangjiao was transferred.
units.literal: That year among the newly passed jinshi was one Li Guan who should not have been listed; public criticism was loud; the Secretariat and Chancellery struck his name from the rolls because the poetry and fu he submitted violated rhyme rules; therefore Shangjiao was transferred.

units.zh: 丁丑，幸南莊，賜從官射。
units.en: On dingchou, the Emperor visited the Southern Villa and granted the attending officials an archery session.
units.literal: On dingchou, the Emperor visited the Southern Villa and granted the attending officials archery.

units.zh: 命客省使向訓權知延州軍州事。
units.en: Commissioner of the Guests Bureau Xiang Xun was ordered to act as administrator of Yanzhou military and prefectural affairs.
units.literal: Commissioner of the Guests Bureau Xiang Xun was ordered to act as administrator of Yanzhou military and prefectural affairs.
